name: The Promise of Twilight
source:
Tia, the daughter of nobility, ventures into the forbidden forest to escape her tedious daily life.
There she encounters a poor boy abandoned by the gods.

[From [url=https://kinako0v0v.itch.io/the-promise-of-twilight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
贵族之女蒂亚为了逃避繁琐的日常生活，冒险进入禁林。
在那里，她遇到了一个被众神抛弃的可怜男孩。

[来自[url=https://kinako0v0v.itch.io/the-promise-of-twilight]itch.io[/url]]
